errors.t212Unauthorized: Trading 212 did not accept the key and secret. Check you copied both (the secret is shown only once), or generate a new key and update the credentials.
errors.t212Forbidden: The key is missing a read permission. Generate a new key with Account data, Metadata, Portfolio and History switched on (see step 3 of the guide).
errors.t212RateLimited: Trading 212 is rate-limiting requests. Nothing to do — the next sync retries automatically.
errors.ibkrExpired: The Flex token has expired. Generate a new one in Client Portal and update the credentials with its new expiry date.
errors.ibkrIp: The Flex token is restricted to a different IP address. Update the IP in Flex Web Service Configuration or generate a token without IP restriction.
errors.ibkrQueryId: IBKR does not recognise the query ID. Use the number shown next to your Activity Flex Query.
errors.ibkrToken: IBKR does not recognise the token. Copy it again from Flex Web Service Configuration (a new token invalidates the old one).
errors.ibkrNoStatement: IBKR has no statement for this account yet (error 1003). Check that the Query ID is the number of your Activity Flex Query, with Period "Last 365 Calendar Days", and that the account already has activity.
errors.ibkrLocked: IBKR temporarily blocked the token after too many failed attempts (error 1025). Automatic syncs pause for 12 hours — don't press Sync meanwhile, it extends the block. If it persists, generate a new Flex token and update the connection.

guide.title: How to connect
guide.subtitle: Step-by-step: create read-only credentials at your broker and paste them here.
guide.security: This app only calls the brokers' read endpoints and blocks anything else before a request leaves your server. Credentials are stored encrypted on your server, never shown again, never logged and never shared with AI clients.

t212.intro: Trading 212 has no "log in with Trading 212" option: you create an API key in the app. Each key covers one account (Invest or Stocks ISA — CFD and SIPP are not supported).

1.title: Open Trading 212 on the right account
1.body: In the app or on the web, switch to the Invest or Stocks ISA account you want to track.

2.title: Open the API settings
2.body: Go to Menu (☰) → Settings → API (Beta), accept the risk warning and tap Generate API key. Name it e.g. personal-finance.

3.title: Choose read-only permissions
3.body: Switch on only what the app reads. Anything that places orders or edits pies must stay off — the app would never use it, but a leaked key could.

4.title: Restrict the IP (recommended)
4.body: Choose Restrict access to trusted IPs and enter your server's public IP. Pick Unrestricted only if that IP changes often.

5.title: Copy the key and the secret
5.body: Tap Generate. You get an API key and an API secret — the secret is shown only once, so copy both now.

6.title: Paste them here
6.body: Click + Trading 212, paste the key and secret, keep Live and save. The first sync starts right away; if something is wrong the card tells you what to fix.

on.2: Metadata — instrument names, ISIN, ETF or stock

t212.revoke: Revoke anytime: Trading 212 → Settings → API (Beta) → select the key → Delete. The key stops working immediately.
t212.csv: The API has no valuation history and no dividend withholding tax. Export your history (Trading 212 → History → Export, CSV) and use Import CSV on the connection card to backfill older data — duplicates are ignored. Without any key you can still record trades by hand in Portfolio.

ibkr.intro: IBKR only offers OAuth to approved companies, so individual accounts connect through the Flex Web Service: a report (Flex Query) plus a token. It is reporting-only — it cannot trade.

1.title: Open Flex Queries
1.body: Log in to Client Portal and go to Performance & Reports → Flex Queries.

2.title: Create an Activity Flex Query
2.body: Next to Activity Flex Query click + and name it e.g. personal-finance.

3.title: Tick these sections
3.body: In each section choose Select All fields (simplest), with the option shown in brackets.

4.title: Set the delivery configuration
4.body: Format XML · Period Last 365 Calendar Days · Date format yyyyMMdd · Time format HHmmss · Date/time separator ; (semicolon). Save and confirm.

5.title: Note the Query ID
5.body: Back in the list, the Query ID is the number shown for your query (use the info icon if it is hidden).

6.title: Generate the Flex token
6.body: On the same page open Flex Web Service Configuration (gear icon), enable it and click Generate A New Token. Pick the expiry (up to 1 year), optionally restrict it to your server's IP, and copy the token.

7.title: Paste them here
7.body: Click + Interactive Brokers, paste the token and the query ID and enter the token's expiry date. The first sync backfills several years and can take a few minutes.
